findings.title: Renamed function breaks downstream usage
findings.body: Renaming `get_forecast` to `fetch_forecast` on line 7 breaks the import in `weather/alerts.py` (line 3 of the RAG excerpt), which still calls `get_forecast`. This will raise `ImportError` at runtime. Revert the rename or update all call sites.

summary.problem: Renaming `get_forecast` to `fetch_forecast` breaks an existing import in `weather/alerts.py`.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
